summary: Phân phối OpenTelemetry Collector với khả năng pipeline lập trình để thu thập, xử lý và xuất telemetry dữ liệu.
usecases: Collecting metrics and logs from microservices and forwarding to Grafana Loki or Prometheus
Transforming and enriching telemetry data before storage or visualization
Standardizing observability data across heterogeneous infrastructure
ideas: Building custom pipeline plugins to integrate proprietary metrics sources with Grafana dashboards
Using Alloy as a lightweight sidecar for edge device telemetry aggregation
Combining Alloy with OpenTelemetry SDKs for automated tracing in serverless environments
